title: Developers build creative apps for Apple's foldable iPhone
excerpt: Developers are creating clever applications designed specifically to utilize the unique potential of Apple's first foldable iPhone.
body_html:
Developers are utilizing the capabilities of Apple's first foldable iPhone by building creative and clever applications.

New software designed for the device includes a variety of unique concepts. Among the creations are retro cassette players, virtual notebooks, flight trackers, and even a digital toaster.

These applications highlight the potential and versatility of the foldable form factor as software creators adapt to the new hardware.
